title: stelf.toml
description: JSON Schema for STELF project files (stelf.toml), generated from stelf.tosd version 1.0.0.

interactive.description: The group to load by default when opening the REPL without specifying one. If omitted, the user must name a group explicitly on the command line. Does not affect how this file behaves when used as a dependency.

group.description: The list of groups defined in this file.

name.description: A valid STELF identifier: any non-whitespace, non-bracket character sequence, with %%. as an escape prefix for special characters.

dependencyExternal.description: An external dependency: downloaded from a URL into a local directory, then treated as a local dependency rooted at that directory.

path.description: The local directory to download into.

action.description: What to do with the downloaded content (treated as another dependency).

dependencyInstalled.description: An installed (system-level) dependency, identified by name.

name.description: The canonical name of the installed package.

alias.description: The toplevel namespace under which this package is imported in the project. Defaults to the package name if omitted.

dependencyLocal.description: A local dependency defined in a *.toml file on disk.

path.description: Path to the dependency's .toml file. Defaults to the current file.

name.description: The name of the group within that file to depend on.

alias.description: The toplevel namespace under which this dependency is imported. Defaults to the group name if omitted.

dependencyShort.description: A shorthand local dependency: just a name, equivalent to a dependencyLocal with only the name field set (path defaults to the current file).

dependency.description: A dependency is any one of the four forms: external, installed, local, or shorthand.

group.description: A group (also called a theory) is the unit of modularity in STELF. Each group has a name, a root file, source directories, and dependencies.

name.description: The name of this group, used to refer to it as a dependency.

main.description: The entry-point file loaded when this group is imported. It is responsible for opening (re-exporting) other files in the group.

src.description: Source directories that form the base search paths for this group's files. Omission is equivalent to a list containing only ".".

dependencies.description: The list of other groups this group depends on. Omission is equivalent to an empty list.

local.description: If true, this group cannot be used as a dependency by other groups; it can only be loaded directly at the REPL or CLI. Defaults to false.
